title: Master of Information Technology
description: Provides graduates with knowledge and skills to explain and apply appropriate IT methodologies to help individuals or organisations achieve goals and objectives.

specialisations.name: Applied Computing
specialisations.description: Focus on practical computing skills across software, data, and systems.

specialisations.name: Artificial Intelligence
specialisations.description: Deep dive into AI, machine learning, and intelligent systems.

specialisations.name: Software Systems
specialisations.description: Advanced software engineering, cloud systems, and cybersecurity.

conversionUnits.note: Introduction to Cybersecurity — for non-cognate students
Computational Thinking with Python — for non-cognate students
Relational Database Management Systems — for non-cognate students
Systems Programming — choose CITS2002 or CITS2005
Object Oriented Programming — choose CITS2002 or CITS2005

groups.name: Group A
groups.note: Take at least 6 points from Group A. Total 24 points from Groups A, B, and C combined.

groups.name: Group B
groups.note: Take at least 6 points from Group B, including at least 6 points of Level 5 units.

groups.name: Group C
groups.note: Depending on conversion units credited. Specialisation-specific units.

units.title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
units.description: Foundational cybersecurity concepts. Incompatible with CITS3004 Cybersecurity.

units.title: Computational Thinking with Python
units.description: Computational problem-solving with Python. Students enrolled in 62510 MIT are pre-approved without ATAR prerequisites.

units.title: Relational Database Management Systems
units.description: Relational database design and SQL. Incompatible with CITS2232 Databases.

units.title: Systems Programming
units.description: Systems-level programming with C. Prerequisite: CITS1401 or equivalent.

units.title: Object Oriented Programming
units.description: Object-oriented programming with Java. Corequisite: CITS1401.

units.title: Fundamentals of Data Science
units.description: Foundational data analysis and computational thinking for postgraduate IT students. Offered in Semester 2.

units.title: Natural Language Processing
units.description: Statistical and neural NLP techniques. Prerequisite: CITS1401 or equivalent.

units.title: Software Requirements and Design
units.description: Core unit. Software requirements engineering and design methodologies.

units.title: Computer Vision
units.description: Image processing and visual learning techniques. Incompatible with CITS4240.

units.title: Computational Modelling
units.description: Computational simulation and modelling techniques.

units.title: Artificial Intelligence and Adaptive Systems
units.description: Search, reasoning, and intelligent agent methods. Prerequisites: CITS2002/2005 + CITS1401/4009.

units.title: Open Source Tools and Scripting
units.description: Linux environments, shell scripting, and open source development workflows.

units.title: Human Aspects of Cybersecurity
units.description: Human factors in cybersecurity including social engineering and usable security.

units.title: Data and Information Technologies Research Project Part 1
units.description: Research project Part 1. Requires WAM ≥70% and 24 points of level 4/5 units completed.

units.title: Data and Information Technologies Research Project Part 2
units.description: Research project Part 2. Continuation of CITS5014.

units.title: Deep Learning
units.description: Neural network architectures and deep learning workflows.

units.title: Information Technology Capstone Project
units.description: Core unit. Capstone project integrating technical design and professional practice. Requires 66 points completed.

units.title: Cloud Computing
units.description: Distributed systems, cloud architecture, and scalable services. Require CITS2002/2005 or equivalent.

units.title: Agile Web Development
units.description: Core unit. Modern web development with agile methodologies. Prerequisite: CITS1401.

units.title: The Internet of Things
units.description: IoT systems, sensors, and embedded programming.

units.title: Ethics and Critical Thinking
units.description: Core unit for MIT. Ethical reasoning and critical thinking for IT professionals.

units.title: Mobile Robots
units.description: Robotics and autonomous systems.

units.title: Geographic Information Systems Applications
units.description: GIS techniques and spatial data analysis.

units.title: Supply Chain Management
units.description: Supply chain and logistics management.

units.title: Business Intelligence
units.description: Business intelligence and data-driven decision making.

units.title: Data Analysis and Decision Making
units.description: Statistical analysis for management decision making.

units.title: Wicked Problems
units.description: Interdisciplinary approaches to complex societal challenges.
